findings.label: Score breakdown diverges from sort order
findings.description: getPrioritizedTasks recomputes score_breakdown live on stored rows using a time-sensitive urgency function. The breakdown total drifts from the stored priority_score that drives sort order, so the per-task breakdown contradicts the ranking returned in the same response.
findings.action: Recompute priority_score live in getPrioritizedTasks and sort on the recomputed value so breakdown and sort key are always derived from the same calculation.

findings.label: Archived tasks block optimizer recommendations
findings.description: optimizeSession checks depTask.status !== 'done' to gate recommendations. Archived dependencies (status='archived') satisfy this check, permanently suppressing dependent tasks from every session recommendation with no diagnostic to the caller.
findings.action: Treat both 'done' and 'archived' as satisfying the dependency gate: !['done', 'archived'].includes(depTask.status).

findings.label: No status validation on task creation
findings.description: createTask accepts any string as the status field. A task created with status='archived' or an arbitrary value silently bypasses listTasks filters and corrupts optimizer logic. The schema has no CHECK constraint on status values.
findings.action: Whitelist ['pending', 'in_progress', 'done'] as valid creation statuses and return 400 for any other value.
